excerpt.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
excerpt.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

label.en: Let's see what can be done.

label.en: We will not forget this tragedy.

label.en: Deploy an administrative task force. Code mauve.

label.en: Deploy an administrative task force. Code mauve.

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
texts.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

texts.zh: 长期暴露在[Root.GetName]大气中的花粉会对信息素受体产生轻微催情效果，随之而来的是一种不易察觉的“兴奋”。而效果最强的植物在这颗星球各处都很常见；被[Root.GetName]的科学家储存在了一个隐蔽的地方，在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]当地语言中被称为“玛琳·卡琳”。
texts.en: Long-term exposure to the pollen naturally occurring in [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere acts on the colonists' pheromone receptors with a mild aphrodisiac effect, accompanied by a barely-perceptible "high." The plant that produces the most potent strain is a flower common to all areas of the planet; squirreled away into some obscure taxonomic nook by scientists on [Root.GetName] but known in the local [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] dialect as "Mharin Kharin."

label.zh: 我们不能让这种影响心智的东西留在大气中。
label.en: We cannot allow mind-altering particles in the atmosphere.

label.zh: 我们能彻底消灭这种植物的手段。
label.en: We do not have the resources to exterminate the plant.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：准备应付花朵
title.en: Mharin Kharin: Making Time for Petals

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的报告显示最近的工作效率开始下降，在比[Root.Owner.GetName]的平均值低好几个百分点的地方稳定下来。

这有可能是由星球上的刺激性花粉造成的。

很可能是。

已发起特殊项目来进一步，以期提高生产线效率来弥补损失。
texts.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] indicate that worker productivity has declined recently, becoming stable at levels several percent lower than the [Root.Owner.GetName] average.

This may or may not be due to the stimulating effects of the pollen native to the planet.

It probably is.

A Special Project has been prepared should we wish to make our production pipelines more efficient to make up for the loss.

label.en: Let's see what can be done.

texts.zh:
通过对[Root.GetName]上的时间管理模型进行深刻革命，并对所有生产领域的责任和各项职责进行重新分配，我们收到了良好的效果。大众的要求显而易见，而外界观察者会将其称作公开需求，那就是要与当地的植物群落保持紧密的联系。

可是即使运用合理的时间分配和额外的即时检查，生产效率仍旧很低，只是至少已经脱离了不可接受的最低水平。
texts.en:
Far-reaching changes to time management paradigms and the way responsibility is delegated within all fields of production and other duties on [Root.GetName] have produced good results. The populace has an evident desire - outside observers would call it an outright need - to be in close proximity to the native flora.

With clever scheduling and additional checks in place, productivity remains low but has risen above the lower limit of what can be deemed acceptable.

texts.zh:
最近的调查报告显示，[Root.GetName]上的居民比[Root.Owner.GetName]的其他居民更不愿意迁移到其他殖民地。

玛琳·卡琳和它的近亲植物会造成一种轻度的心理上的感知依赖。但是调查报告中并没有指明两件事情之间有任何关联。
texts.en:
A recent survey indicates that residents of [Root.GetName] are much less likely than other denizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to migrate to other colonies.

The survey does not address whether this could be due to a psychological dependency on the low-level sensory arousal caused by Mharin Kharin and its sibling-plants.

texts.zh: 尽管星球上的生产力不再下降了，[Root.GetName]上殖民城市和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上首府之间的通信却开始崩溃。[Root.GetName]上的高级官员之间开始变得越来越冷淡，我们的办事员不断抱怨说即使只是发送一个简单的指令现在都变成了一件困难重重的事。
texts.en: While productivity is no longer declining on the planet, communications between the colony on [Root.GetName] and the capital on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] are breaking down. Senior officials on [Root.GetName] are growing increasingly distant, and our clerks are complaining that even relaying simple directives is becoming an exercise in frustration.

label.zh: 派遣一支行政特遣队。代号淡紫。
label.en: Deploy an administrative task force. Code mauve.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：高层统治者的背叛

texts.zh: 我们送去[Root.GetName]处理问题的行政小队好像背叛了。幸运的是，他们的计划起到的作用简直是微乎其微。他们的计划进行得极慢，一下子就被我们发现了，真是一点都不令人感到惊奇。风水轮流转——这只是个比喻而已——我们最后的手段就是废除当地的政府，然后直接从首府那里管理殖民地的事务。
texts.en: It appears that the crack team of administrators we sent to [Root.GetName] in order to set things straight have been turned. Fortunately for us, their plot to do as little work as possible was, unsurprisingly, sloppily executed and easily discovered. Heads will roll - metaphorically speaking of course - as our last recourse is to depose the local government and manage the colony's affairs from the capital.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：远处来的铁腕
title.en: Mharin Kharin: With an Iron Fist, From Afar

texts.zh: 我们的从属政策已经在[Root.GetName]上根深蒂固了。它成功地控制了花粉植物玛琳·卡琳的繁殖。它还成功减少了人们对“使用”这种植物的接受度——这成就可不小，因为这种行为和闻闻花香一样没什么可指摘的。
texts.en: Our remote-government of [Root.GetName] is now firmly established. It has met with some success in suppressing the proliferation of the pollen-bearing plant Mharin Kharin as well as in eroding the community's acceptance of "using" it - no small feat considering the act is as innocent as smelling a flower.

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上面的从属治理一直在进行着生硬而卓有成效的管理。据说掌控大权的国会——显然他们更喜欢躲在房间里呼吸玛琳·卡琳的花粉——已经控制了我们安排在星球上面的一支军团。从属治理希望用这些部队对那些花发起一次进攻，让他们安装一些大气过滤机，并把这种植物从市区完全抹除。
texts.en: Our remote-governance of [Root.GetName] continues to be a somewhat awkward but effective arrangement. The council in charge has allegedly secured the loyalty of a faction of our armed forces on the planet - apparently they prefer staying indoors to breathing in the Mharin Kharin pollen. The remote-government wishes to use these troops to mount an offensive on the flower, having them erect atmospheric purifiers and wiping the plant from all urban areas entirely.

label.en: We should have done this a long time ago.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的边缘分子联合起来，组成了一个准宗教事务性质的组织。他们想要控制玛琳·卡琳的种植。他们的领袖，一个自封为“圣花宫殿”的“绿色祭司”的人，宣称他为[Root.GetName]上的整个生态圈代言，并要求获得这种植物的独家贸易权。

这当然是不可能的，我们也不会接受。[Root.GetName]当地植物体系并没有什么战略或经济价值，因此依法也不能运送到其它星球。

不幸的是，他们似乎很不情愿接受这个现实。
texts.en:
Fringe elements on [Root.GetName] have banded together to form a quasi-religious organization seeking to control all aspects of the Mharin Kharin flower and its cultivation. Their leader, a self-styled "Green Hierophant" of this "Flower Temple" claims to speak for all flora and fauna of [Root.GetName] and demands exclusive trading rights for the plant.

This is of course completely unacceptable and impossible, as the native flora of [Root.GetName] is of little strategic or economic value and thus may not be brought off-world by law.

Unfortunately, they are unlikely to accept this fact gracefully.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：花粉末日的先兆
title.en: Mharin Kharin: Beginning of Pollen's End

texts.zh:
圣花宫殿和它的追随者们的人数现在在[Root.GetName]的总人口中占了不小的比例。报告显示，他们组织的运动出现了一些可疑的改变。他们越来越不热心于走私玛琳·卡琳。圣花宫殿似乎逐渐转变成了一种相信世界末日的宗教事务。大气检测器发现玛琳·卡琳的花粉近期出现了一些变化，也许此事和圣花宫殿的改变有关联。

已发起特殊项目来评估此事可能会带来的风险。建议在可能的灾难发生前完成这个项目。
texts.en:
The Flower Temple and its followers now make up a sizable minority of the population on [Root.GetName], and reports indicate a disturbing change in the movement. Their futile attempts to smuggle Mharin Kharin specimen off-world have been growing less enthusiastic by the day, as the Flower Temple seems to be transitioning into a doomsday cult. There is likely a correlation with the recent changes in the Mharin Kharin pollen's chemical makeup, detected by atmospheric sensors.

A Special Project has been prepared to assess the risks associated with this, and it is recommended to complete it before something goes horribly wrong.

texts.zh:
坚决而迅速的反制措施使我们迅速发现了[Root.GetName]上原生花朵的花粉变化所带来的危险。我们迅速采取了必要措施。

我们彻底疏散了星球上的人群，并且针对玛琳·卡琳及其近亲植物进行了多轮战术性除草轰炸。

这些植物很快就变得对除草剂免疫了。如果这些花粉没有被清除的话，它们就会开始散发一种神经剧毒。所有拥有嗅觉器官的[Root.GetName]生物都会受到致命威胁。

殖民议会的科学家认为这是[Root.GetName]上的一种自然循环。虽然花粉会对我们产生种种不良影响：使我们的当地管理瘫痪，引导圣花骑士教团建立，甚至最终产生剧毒。但是这其实只是偶然的副作用，而不是植物为了自卫而设计的阴谋诡计。

如今，星球的表面上如今已经见不到这些花的踪迹了。我们的殖民地居民们也得到了安全保障，再也不用受到花粉的威胁了。
texts.en:
Quick and decisive action allowed us to identify the risks associated with the rapid changes in the pollen native to [Root.GetName] and take the necessary steps.

The necessary steps were a complete planetary evacuation and a planet-wide tactical pesticide bombing run, targeting the Mharin Kharin flower and its ilk.

The plants were rapidly mutating and their unique pollen would, had they not been destroyed, soon have begun delivering a potent neurotoxin to the olfactory organs of all sapient life on [Root.GetName].

The scientists on the colonization council theorize that this is part of a natural cycle on [Root.GetName] and that the pollen's adverse effects on us, in the form of a crumbling local administration, the rise of the Flower Temple cult, and eventual pollen toxicity, were chance side-effects rather than the product of a plant's sinister self-defense mechanism.

Regardless, any and all traces of the flower have been wiped from the planet's surface, and our colonists are safe and free of the pollen's influence.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：我们的花粉末日
title.en: Mharin Kharin: The Pollen's End of Us

texts.zh:
灾难降临了。

无数的玛琳·卡琳开始自发地进行变异，就像野火那样一发不可收拾地蔓延开来。它们的花粉开始变得剧毒，我们已经束手无策了。

因为我们发现的太晚，我们没能撤离星球上的居民，中和花粉的尝试也以失败告终。[Root.GetName]上的居民遭受了灭顶之灾。

[Root.GetName]上的植物获得了胜利，但是它们也将付出代价，尽管这件事对我们来说只是一种毫无意义的安慰。玛琳·卡琳所属的种群由于过度繁殖，导致土壤中缺少它所需要的某种营养物质——很快，这些植物就会死亡。要经过非常长得一段时间以后，这些植物才能重新在生态系统中找到自己的落脚点。谁知道它们到底会不会找到。

[Root.GetName]的居民都丧生了。星球的大气由于植物排放的气体而暂时变得有毒。
texts.en:
Something went horribly wrong.

Vast swaths of Mharin Kharin flowers spontaneously mutated in unison, spreading like wildfire and turning their pollen poisonous, and we were too late.

Both our evacuation efforts and our attempts to neutralize the pollen fell short of the mark and the inhabitants of [Root.GetName] paid the price.

The plant life of [Root.GetName] achieved only a pyrrhic victory, though this fact is scant consolation. The whole genus that Mharin Kharin belonged to burned in the fire of its own unnaturally rapid proliferation. The soil is starved of the specific nutrients the pollinating plants need - once the currently living specimens die, which will be soon, it will be a long time before that flora can again establish a foothold in the ecosystem, if it ever will.

The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] are dead, and the planet's atmosphere is temporarily noxious with plant emissions.

label.zh: 我们不会忘却这场悲剧的。
label.en: We will not forget this tragedy.

title.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：一个新的开始

texts.zh:
行星调查队伍汇报说，两年之前导致殖民地毁灭的植物毒性瘴气如今已经挥发殆尽了。这颗星球如今已经不同了。在玛琳·卡琳的怒放之后，它现在变成了一颗寸草不生的沙漠星球，大气中到处弥漫着花粉。

两年也许不足以令我们遗忘[Root.Owner.GetName]曾经居住的那些人所遭遇的悲剧，但是至少现在这颗行星对智慧生命不再抱有敌意了。
texts.en:
A planetary surveillance team reports that the toxic miasma that enveloped a planet two years ago and led to the destruction of our colony has lifted. The planet is different now, changed into a desert world after the violent blooming of Mharin Kharin and the atmosphere becoming saturated with pollen.

It will take more than these two years for the [Root.Owner.GetName] to forget the tragic fate of those who lived there, but the planet itself is no longer actively hostile to sapient life.

texts.zh: 在仔细检查之后，我们发现[Root.GetName]上的植物其实构造非常简单。其中一些花粉有淡淡的刺激性以及迅速变异的倾向；但没有其他的特别之处，没有什么战略用途，也不是什么奢侈品资源。
texts.en: On closer examination, the plants native to [Root.GetName] turn out to be rather dull. Some excrete pollen that have a mild stimulating effect and they are likely to have a propensity for rapid genetic change; hardly impressive enough to warrant adopting as a strategic or luxury resource.

texts.zh: 星球的当地的一些植物呈现出许多潜在的有趣特性。
texts.en: Some of the planet's native flora exhibit several potentially interesting properties.

texts.zh: 最近，名声在外的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]学术中心提出了一些组织大量劳动力的可行方法。一项对这些新方法的彻底研究可以解决在富有挑战性的殖民地环境中生产力衰退的问题。
texts.en: Several recent studies from reputable [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seats of learning present a number of alternative ways of arranging a vast workforce. An exhaustive meta-study of these new ideas could provide the answer to the problem of declining productivity in challenging colony environments.

texts.zh:
行星上花粉感染的状况变成了某种潜在的威胁。一项对殖民地状况特别是其愈加不稳定的环境因素的快速评估至关重要。

一旦了解了所有的威胁，可以在几小时内制定并执行一个应对方案。
texts.en:
The situation on the pollen-infested planet has taken a turn for the potentially dangerous. A speedy assessment of the colony's unique situation and especially its increasingly volatile environmental factors is of the utmost importance.

Once all threats are known, an action plan can be drafted and executed within hours.
